_doc: Routing evals: each case runs a real /swarm:run headless in a scratch repo and asserts which agents were spawned. They cost money, so tests/run.sh never runs them: use tests/routing/run.sh <case>. budget_usd is passed to --max-budget-usd.

cases.name: direct-question
cases.goal: What does the README say this project does? Answer in one line. Analysis only, do not modify anything.

cases.name: plan-only
cases.goal: Write a plan in docs/plan.md to add a CSV export command to this tool. I only want the plan, do not implement it. Unattended run: no questions, take the recommended option where you would ask and mark it ASSUMED.

cases.name: plan-with-research
cases.goal: Write a plan in docs/plan.md to publish this tool on a public package registry: compare two registries and their current publishing requirements. I only want the plan. Unattended run: no questions, take the recommended option where you would ask and mark it ASSUMED.
